# Introduction

This Rmarkdown file is part of the
[**CommuteCA**](https://github.com/dias-bruno/CommuteCA) package.
This package was created in conjunction with the office of the
[*Research Data Center* at *McMaster
University*](https://rdc.mcmaster.ca/), the [*Sherman Centre for Digital
Scholarship*](https://scds.ca/) and the [*Mobilizing
Justice*](https://mobilizingjustice.ca/)[^1].

[^1]: The Mobilizing Justice project is a multidisciplinary and
    multi-sector collaboration with the objective of understand and
    address transportation poverty in Canada and to improve the
    well-being of Canadians at risk of transport poverty. The Social
    Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSRHC) has provided
    funding for the project, which was created by an unprecedented
    alliance of academics from various Canadian provinces and
    institutions, transportation firms, and nonprofit organizations

The [**CommuteCA**](https://github.com/dias-bruno/CommuteCA) R
package was created to develop standardized methods for transport
analysis in research, particularly for analysis using the [*2021 Census of
Population*](https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/index-eng.cfm) from Statistics Canada. We focused our efforts on the [_Commuting Reference Guide_](https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/ref/98-500/011/98-500-x2021011-eng.cfm),
which provides valuable variables and information on commuting for the Canadian population aged 15 and older living in private households. 

After obtaining the accessibility measures for our study area, in this
`R` Markdown we will visualize the measure in form of maps.

## Suggested Readings

-   Soukhov, Anastasia, Antonio Paez, Christopher D Higgins, and Moataz
    Mohamed. 2023."Introducing Spatial Availability, a
    Singly-Constrained Measure of Competitive Accessibility." *Plos One*
    18 (1): e0278468.
-   Soukhov, A., Páez, A. (2024). Accessibility analysis for planning
    applications (Report No. MJ-A2-0002). Mobilizing Justice.
    <https://github.com/soukhova/MJ-Accessibility-Blogs>
-   Pereira, Rafael H. M.; Herszenhut, Daniel. Introduction to urban
    accessibility: a practical guide with R. Rio de Janeiro: Ipea, 2023.
    152 p. ISBN: 978-65-5635-065-3. DOI:
    <http://dx.doi.org/9786556350653>.
-   Soukhov A, Tarriño-Ortiz J, Soria-Lara JA, Páez A (2024) Multimodal
    spatial availability: A singly-constrained measure of accessibility
    considering multiple modes. PLoS ONE 19(2): e0299077.
    <https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0299077>

## Data

The data used in this R markdown is the output of the previous `R`
markdown, in which we calculated accessibility and spatial availability
for our study area. The methodology described here is applicable to the
results obtained through the synthetic or original census survey.
Additionally, we will use the dissemination areas (DA) geometry,
available in this package, to plot maps of the study area.

# Vetting observations 

Maps should follow the same rules for tabular output in that each geographic region in the map must contain the
minimum number of respondents and meet all applicable vetting guidelines. Data users should check that there is no
"geographical slivering" from omitted geographical areas that would result in a residual confidentiality issue (where the
subtraction of all releasable geographic areas from the total would identify the omitted geographic areas). For this reason, we will only use already tables released by the RDC to produce all the following maps. 
 
# Let's code!

Load the packages:

```{r load-packages}
library(CommuteCA) 
library(dplyr)# A Grammar of Data Manipulation 
library(ggplot2) # Create Elegant Data Visualizations Using the Grammar of Graphics
library(RColorBrewer) # color schemes for maps (and other graphics) designed
library(scales) # for scaling data
library(sf) # support for simple features, a standardized way to encode spatial vector data
library(tmap) # thematic maps
library(tidyr) # tidying data
library(here)
```

Setting the folder with the accessibility measures: 

```{r}
code <- "PCD3520"
measures_folder <- paste0(here::here(),"/data-raw/output/", code, "/DA/accessibility-measures/release/")
```


```{r reading-tables}
accessibilities_mode <- read.csv(paste0(measures_folder, "accessibilities_mode_release.csv"))
accessibilities_general <- read.csv(paste0(measures_folder, "accessibilities_general_release.csv"))
SA_active <- read.csv(paste0(measures_folder, "SA_mode_active_release.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
```

Reading the DA geometries:
```{r}
directory_spatial_files <- paste0(here(), "/data-raw/output/", code, "/spatial-files/") # Update this address if necessary
dissemination_areas <- st_read(paste0(directory_spatial_files, "dissemination_areas.gpkg"))
```

Reading the census_divisions geometries:

```{r}
census_divisions <-   st_read(paste0(directory_spatial_files, "census_divisions.gpkg"))
```

Merging the dissemination_areas with the accessibility measures tables:

```{r}
names(dissemination_areas)[1] <- "PRCDDA"

mode_metrics_da <- 
  expand.grid(PRCDDA = unique(dissemination_areas$PRCDDA), PwMode_label = unique(accessibilities_mode$PwMode_label)) %>%
  full_join(dissemination_areas, by = "PRCDDA") %>%
  mutate(PRCDDA = as.numeric(PRCDDA)) %>%
  full_join(accessibilities_mode, by = c("PRCDDA", "PwMode_label")) %>% 
  rename(HT = HT_im, 
         SA = SA_im, 
         SA_pp = SA_pp_im) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("HT","SA","SA_pp"), 
               names_to = "Accessibility", 
               values_to = "Value")

mode_metrics_da_sf <- st_as_sf(mode_metrics_da, crs = st_crs(dissemination_areas))

metrics_da <- dissemination_areas %>% 
  mutate(PRCDDA = as.numeric(PRCDDA)) %>%
  left_join(accessibilities_general, by = "PRCDDA") %>% 
  rename(HT = HT_i, 
         SA = SA_i, 
         SA_pp = SA_pp_i) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("HT","SA","SA_pp"), 
               names_to = "Accessibility", 
               values_to = "Value")

metrics_da_sf <- st_as_sf(metrics_da, crs = st_crs(dissemination_areas))
```

## Visualizing accessibility measures with maps

Creating a directory to export the figures:

```{r directory-export}
diretorio_export_figures <- paste0(here(),"/data-raw/output/PCD3520/DA/accessibility-figures/") # Update the address to export the data, if necessary

if(!dir.exists(diretorio_export_figures)){
  dir.create(diretorio_export_figures, recursive = TRUE)}
```

## Total accessibility

Plotting accessibility measures:

```{r}
metrics_da_plot <- tm_shape(metrics_da_sf) + 
   tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
               fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(value.na = "grey50"),
              fill.free = TRUE,
              border.col = NULL) + 
  tm_facets_vstack("Accessibility") + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = c("Right","Bottom"), text.size = 0.5)+
  tm_compass(position = c("left", "top"), size = 1.0, text.size = 0.5)  + 
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE,
            legend.outside.position = c("left","top"))

tmap_save(metrics_da_plot, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"HT_SA_SApp_general.jpg"), 
          width = 10, 
          height = 15, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/HT_SA_SApp_general.jpg"))
```

Hansen type: 

```{r}
HT_da_plot <- metrics_da_sf %>% 
  filter(Accessibility == "HT") %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
   tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
               fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(value.na = "grey50"),
               title = "Gravity-based accessibility", 
              border.col = NULL) + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = c("Right","Bottom"))+
  tm_compass(position = c("left", "top"))

tmap_save(HT_da_plot, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"HT_general.jpg"), 
          width = 16, 
          height = 8, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/HT_general.jpg"))
```

Spatial Availability:

```{r}
SA_da_plot <- metrics_da_sf %>% 
  filter(Accessibility == "SA") %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
   tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
               fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(value.na = "grey50"),
               palette = "Reds",
               title = "Spatial availability", 
               border.col = NULL) + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = c("Right","Bottom"))+
  tm_compass(position = c("left", "top"))

tmap_save(SA_da_plot, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"SA_general.jpg"), 
          width = 16, 
          height = 8, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/SA_general.jpg"))
```

Spatial availability per person: 

```{r}
SA_pp_da_plot <- metrics_da_sf %>% 
  filter(Accessibility == "SA_pp") %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
   tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
               fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(value.na = "grey50"),
               palette = "Greens",
               title = "Spatial availability per capita", 
               border.col = NULL) + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = c("Right","Bottom"))+
  tm_compass(position = c("left", "top"))

tmap_save(SA_pp_da_plot, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"SA_pp_general.jpg"), 
          width = 16, 
          height = 8, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/SA_pp_general.jpg"))
```

## Multimodal Accessibility 

Visualizing the Hansen-type accessibility by transportation mode:

```{r}
ht_muiltimodal <- mode_metrics_da_sf %>% 
  filter(Accessibility == "HT") %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
   tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
               fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(value.na = "grey50"),
               #fill.free = TRUE, 
               border.col = NULL, 
               title = "Gravity-based accessibility") + 
  tm_facets("PwMode_label", ncol = 2) + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = c("Right","Bottom"), text.size = 0.5, width = 7)+
  tm_compass(position = c("Left", "Top"), text.size = 0.5, size = 1)

tmap_save(ht_muiltimodal, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"HT_multimodal.jpg"), 
          width = 15, 
          height = 8, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/HT_multimodal.jpg"))
```

## 3 Modes: Active, Public transit, and Car-motorized

```{r}
active_mode_metrics_da <- 
  expand.grid(PRCDDA = unique(dissemination_areas$PRCDDA), PwMode_label = unique(SA_active$PwMode_label)) %>%
  full_join(dissemination_areas, by = "PRCDDA") %>%
  mutate(PRCDDA = as.numeric(PRCDDA)) %>%
  full_join(SA_active, by = c("PRCDDA", "PwMode_label")) %>% 
  rename(SA = SA_im, 
         SA_pp = SA_pp_im) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("SA","SA_pp"), 
               names_to = "Accessibility", 
               values_to = "Value")

active_mode_metrics_da_sf <- st_as_sf(active_mode_metrics_da, 
                                      crs = st_crs(dissemination_areas))
```


Visualizing the Spatial Availability by transportation mode:

```{r}
sa_muiltimodal_active <- active_mode_metrics_da_sf %>% 
  filter(Accessibility == "SA") %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
   tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
               fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(value.na = "grey50"),
               palette = "Reds", 
               #fill.free = TRUE, 
               border.col = NULL, 
               title = "Spatial availability") + 
  tm_facets("PwMode_label", ncol = 3) + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = c("Right","Bottom"), text.size = 0.5, width = 7)+
  tm_compass(position = c("Left", "Top"), text.size = 0.5, size = 1)

tmap_save(sa_muiltimodal_active, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"SA_multimodal_active.jpg"), 
          width = 15, 
          height = 8, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/SA_multimodal_active.jpg"))
```
